entities.name: Re-authentication
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to create a new EPS security context. Messages exchanged during authentication are integrity protected and ciphered using current EPS security context if available.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by MME to establish new or modified EPS security context. Involves SECURITY MODE COMMAND and SECURITY MODE COMPLETE messages.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMMAND
entities.description: Message sent by MME to initiate security mode control. Includes eKSI of new EPS security context and may include new NAS security algorithms. Sent integrity protected with new/modified context but unciphered.

entities.name: SECURITY MODE COMPLETE
entities.description: Message sent by UE in response to SECURITY MODE COMMAND. Sent integrity protected and ciphered with the new or modified EPS security context.

entities.name: eKSI
entities.description: EPS Key Set Identifier included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND message to indicate which EPS security context to use or modify.

entities.name: NAS security algorithms
entities.description: New set of selected NAS security algorithms included in SECURITY MODE COMMAND when modifying current EPS security context.

entities.name: EPS security context
entities.description: Security context used for integrity protection and ciphering of NAS messages. Can be current, new, or modified.

entities.name: Continue using current EPS security context
entities.description: Both UE and MME shall continue to use current EPS security context until MME initiates security mode control procedure.

relations.description: Re-authentication procedure creates a new EPS security context.
Security mode control procedure involves sending SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.
Security mode control procedure involves receiving SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message includes eKSI information element.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message may include NAS security algorithms when modifying context.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is integrity protected with new/modified EPS security context.
SECURITY MODE COMMAND message is sent unciphered.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message is integrity protected with new/modified EPS security context.
SECURITY MODE COMPLETE message is ciphered with new/modified EPS security context.
Condition specifies that current EPS security context should be used until security mode control is initiated.
